parrafo.es: Dro's Barbershop es la barbería de Dro Cruz, abierta desde 2018 y hoy instalada en un nuevo local en 3555 Bayside Lakes Blvd, Palm Bay, FL, tras mudarse de su dirección original en Melbourne. Servicio completo para todo tipo de cabello: fades, trabajo de barba, line ups, afeitados y cortes a tijera, todo reservable en línea por Booksy.
parrafo.en: Dro's Barbershop is Dro Cruz's shop, open since 2018 and now settled into a new space at 3555 Bayside Lakes Blvd in Palm Bay, FL, after moving from its original Melbourne address. Full service barbering for every hair type: fades, beard work, line ups, shaves and scissor cuts, all bookable online through Booksy.

hero.imagen_alt: Side profile of a sharp skin fade with a crisp line up at Dro's Barbershop

parrafo_1.es: Dro Cruz abrió Dro's Barbershop en 2018 con un lema simple, tallado en su propio logo: diversidad, confianza, originalidad. Sus clientes describen lo mismo una y otra vez: trabajo preciso con navaja, máquina y tijera, la capacidad de cortar cualquier tipo de cabello, y un barbero que revisa su propio trabajo varias veces antes de dejarte ir.
parrafo_1.en: Dro Cruz opened Dro's Barbershop in 2018 with a simple motto, carved right into his own logo: diversity, reliability, originality. Clients describe the same thing review after review: precise blade, clipper and scissor work, the ability to cut any hair type, and a barber who checks his own work more than once before letting you go.

parrafo_2.es: En 2026 el negocio se mudó de su local original en Melbourne a un espacio nuevo en Palm Bay, en 3555 Bayside Lakes Blvd. Más de 290 citas reservadas y calificadas en Booksy, y una calificación de 4.9 en reseñas en línea, con clientes recurrentes que siguen la silla adonde se mueva.
parrafo_2.en: In 2026 the shop moved from its original Melbourne location into a new space in Palm Bay, at 3555 Bayside Lakes Blvd. Over 290 appointments booked and reviewed on Booksy, and a 4.9 rating across reviews online, with recurring clients who follow the chair wherever it moves.

items.quote: Dro is precise with his blade/blend/scissor work and takes pride in his art. He can cut any type of hair, listens to his clients, is real personable, and always checks his work multiple times to make sure both the client and himself are satisfied. This is a REAL MASTER at his craft. He is the best barber I've ever had the pleasure of meeting, which you can easily tell by how many recurring clients he has!
Dro is definitely a cut above the rest and is always smiling and always does a great fade
They both gave me absolutely stunning burst fades and it looks immaculate. It cost like $5 more but its worth it
